name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: Action bar above tables and lists: search, filters and actions with a single Tab stop and arrow-key navigation. Start / center / end lanes, groups, separators, links and inputs; buttons use the kit Button styles. Variants: bar, floating, plain.
author: gntik-ai
